markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Tier 1 surgical frozen section with single-class conformal set [F1] and suspected margin involvement [F11].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu 0% (ECE 5%) | Unambiguous top class; small test set |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at α=10% (90% test coverage) | Single class at dataset-level guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 26% OOD, AUROC 70% [F6] | Typical image; passes quality checks |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent foundation models match |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (82%–94% similarity) [F5] | All nearest references match suggestion |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 2, 4) · ↑ invasive · Strongest score (+2.07), above typical [F2]; AI spot check 19/20 · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 2, 6, 9) · ↑ invasive · Second-ranked concept (+1.13) [F3], but unreliable (0/20 AI spot check) · Unreliable
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 2, 6, 9) · ↑ invasive · High score (+0.90) toward invasion [F4]; AI spot check 18/20 · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 4) · ↑ invasive · Low tubules (-1.15) push toward invasion (+0.88); spot check 18/20 · Weak
- **Nuclear size and variation** (regions 1, 4, 8) · context · Mean 77.8 µm² [F7], CV 0.64 [F8] (both 93rd percentile) · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing three highest-risk regions beat random deletion (+0.0114, 95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); leans on unreliable mitoses (0/20), lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Atypical cells are actually duct-confined (like InSitu contrast case BACH_0155, 70% similarity) rather than infiltrating stroma.
- Simulated frozen-section artifacts distort morphology, given 78% benign-classified epithelium [F10] (wrong-direction feature) and 0% immune cells [F9].

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 2, 4**: Confirm true stromal invasion versus duct-confined atypia in highest-risk regions (risk 100%).
2. **Regions 2, 6, 9**: Verify nuclear pleomorphism and manually check unreliable mitoses (0/20) and necrosis (3/20) concepts.
3. **Regions 0, 4, 8**: Check medial (430 µm), superior (215 µm), and inferior (108 µm) margins; stains blocked.
